Name: PCs Rattan Furniture
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][img=center]https://i.imgur.com/UUt0wm0.png[/img][/center]

[left][img=left]https://i.imgur.com/qUn74TP.png[/img]

This mod adds 74 new pieces of furniture in vintage rattan theme, obtainable either through the vanilla furniture catalog or a dedicated Rattan Furniture Catalog (requires Calcifer) that you can buy from Robin. The catalog option is toggleable via config.json.


[img=left]https://i.imgur.com/BQ22QNx.png[/img]

Furniture texture added via AT can be found here:
Artist Bookcase: Rattan Vanity, Rattan Clothing Rack, Rattan Sideboard, Ironing Board, Curio Cabinets, Towel Rack, Bathroom Rack
Bamboo Mat: Small Rug
Bear Statue: Ceiling Hanging Chair, Hammock Chair, Houseplant (Fiddle Fig Tree), Bathroom Sink, Toilet
Bed: Rattan Bed
Birch End Table: Houseplants
Blue Armchair: Rattan Armchair
Blue Couch: Rattan Couch
Brown Couch: Bathtub
Burlap Rug: Round Rattan Rug
China Cabinet: Rattan Partition, Record Player Table, Houseplant (Yucca Palm), L. Plant Stand
Country Lamp: Lamps
Deluxe Tree: Chic Bookcase, Houseplant (Fiddle Fig Tree), Rattan Screen, Bathroom Sink
Double Bed: Rattan Double Bed
Funky Rug: Rattan Rug
Industrial Pipe: Tall Rattan Cabinets
Large Green Rug: Cozy Flower Rug, Runner Rug
Light Green Rug: Brown Rug
Oak Chair: Rattan Chair, Rattan Stool
Oak End Table: Rattan End Tables
Oak Table: Rattan Table (Decorated)
Oak Tea-Table: Rattan Table, Pouf Table, Cozy Workdesk
Pastel Banner: Fashion Decor, Decorative Toilet Paper, Decorative Towel, Toiletries Wall Shelves
Small Plant: Small Decorative Plants, Table Decorations, Decorative Boots, Decorative Basket, Flower Vases
S. Pine: Toilet, Small Basket, Decorative Stool
Walnut End Table: Accent Tables, Racks, Vinyl Record, Laundry Baskets, Decorative Guitar
Wumbus Statue: Houseplants


[img=left]https://i.imgur.com/3UbpxIg.png[/img]

Some of the chairs don't have rotation. I didn't make them as I don't feel the need to use the rotated versions myself. They look best facing front anyway. :D

The AT version has fewer furniture pieces than the CP version because some of the furniture doesn't match the dimensions of vanilla furniture. Some pieces do, but they're not the same type of furniture. I decided to include the latter, though!


[img=left]https://i.imgur.com/3NzENwh.png[/img]

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods]PlatinumCats' mods
[/url]



If you like this mod, don't forget to endorse! That way more people will see it and it'll give my modding spirit a boost. :D 


Happy decorating![/left]
